Management's Q3 guide is non-GAAP diluted EPS $1.06-$1.08 and cannot be added directly to GAAP H1 EPS. Bear tests weaker AI/customer deployment timing, acceptance delays and/or margin pressure; base assumes Q3 demand and margins broadly track management's non-GAAP outlook while GAAP exclusions remain manageable; bull tests stronger AI Ethernet shipments and operating leverage. P/E assumptions of 40x/50x/60x deliberately stress valuation compression versus durable premium growth; they are not observed, fair, normal, or probability-weighted multiples.
